info.name: TIB-031 — Order date range filter (staging)
info.description:
Bo test API cho **TIB-031 — Order date range filter** (project TIB tren Testlane).

Bug goc: merchant loc Orders theo khoang ngay thi order cua **ngay ke tiep** van lot vao list.
Nguyen nhan: `end_date` da duoc Portal quy doi sang UTC roi con bi `->endOfDay()` noi rong lai.

## Moi truong
- Store: `linh-tib-staging.myshopify.com` — instance **58**, timezone **Asia/Bangkok (UTC+7, khong DST)**
- Base: `https://staging-api.teeinblue.com`

## Cach chay
1. Chon environment **TIB Staging - Open API** o goc tren ben phai. Environment nay giu san
   `partnerToken` va cac token scope khac, do `scripts/mktokens.py` tu day len.
2. Dien `userA_email` / `userA_password` trong tab **Variables** cua collection.
3. Chay folder **0. Setup** — lay JWT, chot timezone va ground truth cua 4 order boundary.
4. Chay cac folder con lai.

## Luu y quan trong
- **JWT staging chi song 15 phut.** Thay 401 hang loat thi chay lai `Setup — Login`.
- **Assertion dem so** chi dem trong 4 order boundary da biet, khong dem tong so dong. Staging
  tung bi seed them bo trung moc gio (#ins58-2874..2877) lam vo cach dem tong.
- **Cloudflare chan User-Agent la** (403, error 1010). Moi request da co san header `User-Agent`
  gia trinh duyet — dung xoa.
- Moi moc thoi gian trong collection la **UTC**. Cot DATE tren Portal la **gio store-local (UTC+7)**.
  Chenh lech 7 tieng giua hai con so la binh thuong, khong phai bug.

## Test data — 4 order boundary

| Order | Store-local (UTC+7) | UTC `created_at` | Order item | Vai tro |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| #ins58-2870 | 2026-08-18 23:59:00 | 2026-08-18T16:59:00Z | 6715 | D — truoc range 1 phut |
| #ins58-2871 | 2026-08-20 00:00:00 | 2026-08-19T17:00:00Z | 6716 | C — dau ngay |
| #ins58-2872 | 2026-08-20 23:59:00 | 2026-08-20T16:59:00Z | 6718 | A — cuoi ngay |
| #ins58-2873 | 2026-08-21 00:00:00 | 2026-08-20T17:00:00Z | 6719, 6720 | B — sau range 1 phut |

Range chuan dung xuyen suot: **local Aug 19 – Aug 20** = `2026-08-18T17:00:00.000Z` →
`2026-08-20T16:59:59.999Z`. Ket qua dung: chi C va A.

## Trang thai (staging, 2026-08-24)

| Duong | Ket qua |
|---|---|
| Orders list UI + `/api/orders` | ✅ dung — bien inclusive ca hai dau, chinh xac toi giay |
| `/openapi/v1/orders` (partner, bare date) | ✅ dung — van widen toi cuoi ngay |
| `/api/instances/{id}/order-items` | ✅ **da fix 2026-08-24** — truoc do `end_date` bi `endOfDay()` |
| Range mo mot dau (chi start HOAC chi end) | ❌ **regression moi** — filter bi bo im lang |

Folder dang fail: **5** — 2 request TC-021 (range mo mot dau). Folder **3** da fix va pass.

## Con mo
- Danh sach **day du** cac endpoint dung `Order::scopeByDateRange()` (open question 3) —
  moi verify duoc `/api/orders` va `/api/instances/{id}/order-items`; cac endpoint con lai chua sweep.
- Bare date duoc dien giai theo **ngay UTC**, khong phai ngay store-local. Can PO xac nhan
  day co phai contract mong muon cho partner khong.
- Chua co store UTC-7 va store UTC de chay TC-001..004 dung precondition va TC-006.
